items.prompt:
Repaint INPUT 1, the original enlarged healing card, in broad opaque hand-painted anime style. Preserve its ORIGINAL COMPOSITION and landscape aspect ratio: first-person two open bare hands cupped upward from the bottom corners, a tall slender cylindrical glass bottle floating upright between them at center, the long narrow neck and small stopper reaching near the top crop. Preserve the bottle's relative scale, the hands' supporting gesture, all visible wrists and muted teal sleeve cuffs, the blue healing liquid inside the long bottle, the overhead golden-white light, and the low distant dark horizontal water/ground band across the lower background. Do not replace this with a small round bottle or an isolated bottle still life. No luminous teardrop inside the bottle.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET and locks subject, pose, framing, lighting and background. Input 2, blood-arrow card, is STYLE ONLY for broad opaque paint planes, quiet material masses and selective clear edges, not arrow identity, red color or pose.

Retain the original upper background's warm gold and ivory illumination transitioning to muted gray-green, with broad descending light shapes, and retain the dark blue-gray low horizon. Simplify rays and tiny sparkling points into a few broad soft luminous planes, while keeping the original atmosphere and background layout. The tall bottle keeps a pale glass silhouette and a concentrated cool blue core. Simplify its tiny engraved bands and scratch-like spirals into two or three broad curved glass/blue highlight swaths following the cylinder, a simple quiet rim and a few edge accents. Keep the bottle understandable and translucent-looking without dense ornate engraving. Draw two anatomically readable hands with natural thumbs, separate fingers and connected wrists, faithfully preserving the original palms-up pose; do not add extra hands or turn the pose into clasped fingers.

STYLE: rough hand-painted anime illustration built from large connected opaque color masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs. Broad confident warm and cool planes model palms, wrists and fingers. Selective clear edges at the finger silhouettes and bottle, economical hand crease marks, quiet skin surfaces. Glass and sleeves receive fewer broader paint marks. Clear grouped shadows and decisive handmade edges with a little selective soft light transition; keep broken stroke endings and expressive overlaps around calm areas. Do not flatten every interior into uniform fill, and do not texture every surface. Matte muted gold/gray/teal with concentrated luminous blue in bottle. Faces absent; hands and bottle carry clearest detail. No dense scratches, fine engraved filigree, tiny facet mosaics, all-over grain/canvas filters, photoreal skin or glass, glossy 3D, smooth commercial airbrush, decorative clutter, text, frame, watermark or UI.
